machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

policy.quantized: cumulative early decoder layers selected by --scan
policy.retained_bf16: token embeddings and all norm vectors
policy.execution_emulation: packed values dequantized by output-row chunks with FP32 inputs and accumulation, cast back to the surrounding BF16 dtype

downstream_native_validation.prompt: A red fox asleep beside a mossy stone in soft morning light.
downstream_native_validation.scope: The calibrated up_proj-Q8 embedding replaces text_input.f32 in the pinned native one-step transformer fixture.

decision: Reject the measured text-Q8 policies. Uniform and complete-layer policies fail the text boundary. The least damaging large role policy leaves too little text-error margin and fails the stricter downstream step-1 latent gate while saving only 1.608 GiB.
limitations: PyTorch MPS FP32 matmul is not bit-exact with the future native packed Metal kernel.
The downstream 256px latent and decoded-image gates must pass before this becomes a runtime policy.
